records.pred_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.Consumption) / 12 FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' AND T2.Segment = 'SME'

records.question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'CZK', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'EUR', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
records.pred_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS ConsumptionDifference FROM yearmonth AS y JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

records.question: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1
records.pred_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year FROM yearmonth AS ym INNER JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY year ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.Segment = 'SME' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many more "discount" gas stations does the Czech Republic have compared to Slovakia?
